## Change

JUV- ticket: problem, delivered behavior and scope.

## Validation

Commands run, results, evidence and limitations. Accessibility/security/migration where applicable.

## Handoff

- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified
- [ ] Backlog and STATUS updated
- [ ] Contracts/ADRs/documents adjusted as needed
- [ ] Documentation and code comments are in English
- [ ] No secrets or real data in the diff
- [ ] Rollback described for any migration or release
